name: Myau
source:
A kitten picked up on the roadside turns into a catboy at night. There actually seems to be a species like that, he isn't a monster. He doesn't understand why he turns into a full cat during the daytime and went to Riichi for help.

He doesn't know how he used to live in the place where he used to live, but he's pretty ignorant. He's a sassy nekomimi who only cares about his energy. Solve the mystery with him!

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080611175742/http://www.hanerom.dojin.com/natuiro_nyau.html]official website[/url]]
